summary: Community member urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure broadband access for schools and libraries. The community urges the FCC to protect E-Rate funding and maintain its role in providing reliable broadband access for schools and libraries.

claims.requested_action: Reject proposals to sunset or eliminate E-Rate
claims.argument: E-Rate has enabled schools to provide connectivity necessary for modern education
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate has enabled schools (public and private) and libraries to build and maintain the connectivity necessary for students and patrons to participate fully in modern education.
